name: idle
intent: In-place standing idle loop with subtle whole-body sway and small upper-body/arm adjustments; no locomotion or discrete action.

phases.name: rise-and-first-upper-body-follow-through
phases.description: Rise with the first upper-body follow-through.

keyPoses.description: The pelvis is at its leftmost position in the first sway.
The pelvis reaches its highest position.
The pelvis reaches its lowest position.
The pelvis reaches its right/back extreme during the return.

weightTransfer.description: The pelvis shifts left/forward, rises to f128, reaches its forwardmost point at f163 and lowest point at f182, then travels right/back to f238 before exact loop closure at f250. This pelvis-sway evidence is consistent with a slow weight shift.
weightTransfer.contactCaveat: Support-foot/load identity is not established because the available tracks show pelvis translation and joint rotations but do not directly measure contact force or load distribution.

bodyMechanics.description: The measured angular-deviation timing is staggered and asymmetric: the right upper/lower arm reaches its first-window maximum deviation from f0 at f54, hips rotation at f96, spine and left shoulder at f123, and head at f131. Later, the pelvis reaches its vertical low at f182 before chest and neck reach their second-window maximum angular deviation at f194 and the head follows at f198. This supports staggered coordination, not a proven causal chain.
